meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能够创作或编辑自定义HyperFrames视频作品，适用于较长或多场景片段、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态标题卡片、素材混剪等。它会按项目状态读取或创建BRIEF.md，然后顺序执行计划、审查、构建场景等步骤。
howto.when: 当没有专门的工作流程适用，或BRIEF.md中设置flow为companion时触发。典型时机是用户要求创建或编辑一个视频项目。

say.text: 帮我制作一个30秒的产品宣传片，包含3个场景。
修改我的视频项目中第二个场景的过渡效果。
say.note: Claude会定位到具体编辑任务。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to author or edit custom HyperFrames compositions for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. It reads or creates BRIEF.md based on project state and executes plan, review, build scenes in order.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Typical entry is when user requests creation or editing of a video project.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second product promo with three scenes.
say_en.note: Claude will start the general-video workflow.

say_en.text: Edit the transition of scene 2 in my video project.
say_en.note: Claude will locate and edit the specific scene.
